name: Summer Pre-College Program
what_you_do: Take online college courses taught by Morehouse faculty. Plan on about 50 minutes a day, Monday to Friday. You earn Morehouse College credit for each course you pass.
who_can_apply: High school students who are 16 or older when they apply, in 10th to 12th grade, with at least a 3.2 GPA.
pay_detail: $3,500 flat fee for up to three courses, plus up to $100 per course for books and a $30 non-refundable application fee
duration: About 6 weeks (June 1 to July 10 in 2026, finals July 6 to 10)
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications Jan 5 to Mar 15, 2026, decisions Apr 5, payment due May 1. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Send an online application. Add your official high school transcript and one recommendation from a teacher or counselor. List your top three course choices. Test scores are optional.
notes: Costs money. The page also calls the group rising juniors and seniors in places. Confirm your grade with the Summer Academy (academicsuccess@morehouse.edu). Dates shown are from the 2026 summer.
